guides.definition: A typed declaration creates an object whose lifetime and type are known at compile time.

examples.title: Declare a typed value
examples.code:
int answer = 42;
volatile int sink = answer;
examples.explanation: A typed declaration creates an object whose lifetime and type are known at compile time.

guides.definition: An if statement evaluates a contextual Boolean expression and executes one selected branch.

examples.title: Branch with if
examples.code:
int value = 42;
if (value > 0) { value += 1; } else { value = 0; }
examples.explanation: An if statement evaluates a contextual Boolean expression and executes one selected branch.

guides.definition: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and an iteration expression.

examples.title: Run a counted loop
examples.code:
int total = 0;
for (int index = 0; index < 4; ++index) { total += index; }
examples.explanation: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and an iteration expression.

guides.definition: A range-based for statement visits each element exposed by a compatible range expression.

examples.title: Iterate a native array
examples.explanation: A range-based for statement visits each element exposed by a compatible range expression.

guides.definition: A lambda expression creates an unnamed function object and explicitly controls captured state.

examples.title: Create a lambda
examples.code:
auto doubleValue = [](int value) { return value * 2; };
volatile int answer = doubleValue(21);
examples.explanation: A lambda expression creates an unnamed function object and explicitly controls captured state.

guides.definition: A class defines a user type with explicit access control, constructors, state, and member functions.

examples.title: Declare a class
examples.explanation: A class defines a user type with explicit access control, constructors, state, and member functions.

guides.definition: A scoped enumeration keeps enumerator names inside the enum type and does not implicitly convert to integers.

examples.title: Declare a scoped enum
examples.explanation: A scoped enumeration keeps enumerator names inside the enum type and does not implicitly convert to integers.

guides.definition: A generic lambda uses placeholder parameter types to generate a call operator for each used argument type.

examples.title: Create a generic lambda
examples.code:
auto identity = [](auto value) { return value; };
volatile int answer = identity(42);
examples.explanation: A generic lambda uses placeholder parameter types to generate a call operator for each used argument type.

guides.definition: A structured binding introduces names for the elements of an array or aggregate-like object.

examples.title: Decompose an object
examples.explanation: A structured binding introduces names for the elements of an array or aggregate-like object.

guides.definition: A try block transfers control to a matching catch handler when an exception is thrown.

examples.title: Handle an exception
examples.explanation: A try block transfers control to a matching catch handler when an exception is thrown.
